metadata.trend_analysis_basis: 2026 medical short-form research: provider-led single-question direct-to-camera explainers (30-60s) outperform produced/graphics-heavy cuts; raw presenter-forward delivery reads as more credible than stock-footage-heavy production; save-worthy tips drive shares and search traffic; captions are essential since most viewers watch muted. Applied by: reducing side-panel graphics from every beat to one hero moment (scene_02), switching remaining beats to direct-to-camera with captions as the primary overlay, and adding a compact save-worthy stat card at scene_04.
